text:
nina: RedHive dropped PT-811 into our shared bucket. Highlights: staging KMS key policy grants a deploy role decrypt perms, Dedicated instances missing SSM session transcripts, and API Gateway logs strip bodies for our prod-like routes. Need a scoped remediation plan + evidence package for retest.
ale c: path?
nina: s3://redwood-pt/reports/PT-811/2026-03-18/pt-report.pdf
ram: putting on my sec hat. If the role can decrypt staging artifacts, vendor could exfil config. Suggest immediate mitigation in staging: create replacement key, update alias, revoke principal, and rotate any secrets encrypted under the old key.
alec: agree. will also check terraform state backend encryption; if state uses the same key we must re-encrypt state or migrate. Hot-swap plan: create new CMK, create alias (alias/redwood/staging-v2), update providers, run `terraform state mv` as needed, then re-encrypt state file with `aws kms re-encrypt`.
sec-bot: Created ticket PT-811-REMED (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PT-811-REMED) :spiral_notepad:
oncall: we can schedule changes outside peak hours. if you want me to page SRE, say the window.
nina: logging gaps: 1) Dedicated hosts: SSM StartSession events are logged to CloudTrail but we don't push session-manager transcripts to S3; 2) API Gateway: stage logs capture latency & headers but body is redacted unless flagged. Report recommends keeping full bodies in a locked 90-day bucket for security investigations with strict IAM.
ram: for SSM transcripts we can enable session-manager:StartSession logging to an S3 bucket via the SSM logging config in the account-level SSM Document. Quick check: `aws ssm get-parameter --name /ssm/session-manager/s3-bucket` but actual enforcement is org SCP allowing ssm:StartSession to s3.
ale c: for API bodies we can route security-flagged requests to a separate logging lambda that stores the full payload in s3://redwood-sec-archival/pt-bodies/ with KMS encryption and access logging. 30/90 day retention policy and restricted access.
nina: owners: KMS rekey + terraform -> alec. SSM transcript enable -> ram. API body archival -> nina. Proposed maintenance slot: tonight 01:30-03:00 UTC. OK?
alec: I can do 01:30-02:45 for the key rotation; will run a canary and validate terraform state access. Plan: 1) create CMK + alias 2) patch key policy (remove arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/deploy-finegrained) 3) update TF backend config 4) re-encrypt state. I'll post exact commands to the runbook.
ram: I'll flip SSM session transcript target to s3 and validate delivery with a dummy session. command snippet for runbook: ```aws ssm start-session --target i-0123456789abcdef0 --document-name AWS-StartInteractiveCommand``` and then check s3 bucket for transcript under path `sessions/{instance}/{timestamp}`.
oncall: I'll monitor for lambda errors and be ready to rollback the alias if something breaks.
nina: evidence checklist for vendor: - CMK creation logs (CloudTrail events) - Key policy diff (before/after) - S3 object ACL and bucket policy screenshots - SSM transcript object keys and sample transcript (redacted PII) - API body archival metadata (object key + SHA256) - test replay logs showing exploit path fails. Include checksums.
sec-bot: Evidence bucket created: s3://redwood-pt/evidence/PT-811/ (restricted: team/eng-security only)
alec: sample policy diff I'll include in the ticket: ```- "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/deploy-finegrained"} + /* removed deploy-finegrained principal */```
ram: for audit completeness we should also include a CloudTrail lookup that shows prior uses of the old key: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:...:key/...` and stash the JSON output in the evidence bundle.
nina: retest ask to RedHive: 1) attempt the previously observed escalation path against staging (timeboxed) 2) confirm SSM transcripts capture interactive commands and that transcripts are readable by eng-security only 3) prove API body replay no longer shows tampering surface. propose retest window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC.
alec: sending vendor note now with interim evidence. will include runbook snippets and rollback steps.
oncall: if anything spikes during the window we abort and reassign a postmortem.
nina: thanks all. leave short status pings in this thread during the operation. :white_check_mark:
